title: Updated flagship hardware stack
text: Named components are reference classes for an engineering build. Production selection must also consider lifecycle, regional availability, environmental ratings, serviceability, EMC, calibration, supplier qualification and regulatory evidence.
tables: Jetson AGX Thor developer kit for development; T5000 module + qualified carrier for production [S6-S7]
Essential to APEX; right-size for lower tiers
STM32H7-class MCU, isolated I/O, independent watchdogs and hardware cut-outs
Industrial touch display and separate control computer with encrypted local storage
Teledyne FLIR Oryx ORX-10G-310S9M class: 31 MP, global shutter, 10GigE [S9]
0.238x large-field TitanTL class, ~122.7 mm horizontal FOV on APS-H; final sensor pairing and plate coverage require optical validation [S8]
High-sensitivity color camera with visible and 940 nm NIR response; filterable optical path
Transmitted, epi, oblique, dark-field, polarized, 940 nm NIR and switchable fluorescence channels
Mixed: core modes essential; fluorescence research-only until validated
Eight-channel BME690-class gas-sensor array with controlled sampling and reference channel [S10]
VL53L8CX 8x8 ToF sensor for position, proximity and gross depth [S11]
Laser triangulation, structured light or chromatic/confocal profilometry
Insulated chamber, PT100-class sensing, bidirectional thermal control, active humidity management
O2/CO2 sensing, regulated ports, valves/flow controllers, pressure and exhaust management
Calibrated optical scattering with reference channel and tube identification
96-well broth microdilution deck with transmitted optical reading, kinetic imaging and plate map
24-48 plate queue, barcode/RFID, guarded robotic transport and recovery positions
Essential to flagship automation; not PoC
Purpose-built 8/12-channel pipetting and dispensing module with disposable tips
Medical-grade PSU class, UPS, LiFePO4 backup, emergency stop, fuses, leakage/temperature monitoring
